newsitem.title: EGYPT: Gulf Air orders three drunks to leave plane.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Air orders three drunks to leave plane.

text.p: Egyptian authorities removed three Arab men from a Gulf Air plane because they were drunk, a Cairo airport official said on Sunday.
Reuters on Saturday quoted airport sources as erroneously saying the three were Bahrainis.
"The passengers are Arabs but not Bahrainis," Brigadier Mohamed el-Harthi, director of inspection at the airport's terminal number two, told Reuters.
The Gulf Air plane was flying from Bahrain to Casablanca. The captain of the plane took advantage of a stopover in Cairo to report the three passengers and ask for their removal, the sources said.
